name: Food Twin
description: Digital twin of the US food system showing how food moves from production to consumption. Visualizes supply chain resilience and climate impacts on food security.
embedNote: Food Twin supports embedding with modern web architecture

Software Licensing.note: Open source codebase available on GitHub

Data Licensing.note: Uses satellite data and public survey statistics

Technical Accessibility.note: Modern web app with embedding capabilities

Data Standards.note: Uses standard geospatial and agricultural data formats

Infrastructure.note: Self-hostable but requires data processing setup

Community Governance.note: Collaborative project with limited community input
